hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; ROOT="/home/gabrieletassoni/Git/rubyonrails/thecore_project/pjm-poc/vendor/submodules/model_driven_api"; case "$f" in "$ROOT/AGENTS.md") cp "$ROOT/AGENTS.md" "$ROOT/CLAUDE.md";; "$ROOT/CLAUDE.md") cp "$ROOT/CLAUDE.md" "$ROOT/AGENTS.md";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

ROOT="/home/gabrieletassoni/Git/rubyonrails/thecore_project/pjm-poc/vendor/submodules/model_driven_api"; SKILLS="$ROOT/.agents/skills"; COMMANDS="$ROOT/.claude/commands"; for d in "$SKILLS"/*/; do n=$(basename "$d"); [ -f "$d/SKILL.md" ] && [ ! -e "$COMMANDS/$n.md" ] && ln -sf "../../.agents/skills/$n/SKILL.md" "$COMMANDS/$n.md"; done; for f in "$COMMANDS"/*.md; do [ -L "$f" ] || continue; n=$(basename "$f" .md); [ -d "$SKILLS/$n" ] || rm -f "$f"; done 2>/dev/null || true

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\.agents|\.claude.commands' || exit 0; ROOT="/home/gabrieletassoni/Git/rubyonrails/thecore_project/pjm-poc/vendor/submodules/model_driven_api"; SKILLS="$ROOT/.agents/skills"; COMMANDS="$ROOT/.claude/commands"; for d in "$SKILLS"/*/; do n=$(basename "$d"); [ -f "$d/SKILL.md" ] && [ ! -e "$COMMANDS/$n.md" ] && ln -sf "../../.agents/skills/$n/SKILL.md" "$COMMANDS/$n.md"; done; for f in "$COMMANDS"/*.md; do [ -L "$f" ] || continue; n=$(basename "$f" .md); [ -d "$SKILLS/$n" ] || rm -f "$f"; done 2>/dev/null || true
